name: pdf-parser
summary: Parses a PDF document to identify the fundamental elements used in the analyzed file.
highlights: -s — string to search in indirect objects (except streams)
-f — pass stream object through filters (FlateDecode, ASCIIHexDecode, ASCII85Decode, LZWDecode
-o — id(s) of indirect object(s) to select, use comma (,) to separate ids (version independent)
-r — id of indirect object being referenced (version independent)
-w — raw output for data and filters

flags.name: --version
flags.description: show program's version number and exit

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --man
flags.description: Print manual

flags.name: --search
flags.description: string to search in indirect objects (except streams)

flags.name: --filter
flags.description: pass stream object through filters (FlateDecode, ASCIIHexDecode, ASCII85Decode, LZWDecode and RunLengthDecode only)

flags.name: --object
flags.description: id(s) of indirect object(s) to select, use comma (,) to separate ids (version independent)

flags.name: --reference
flags.description: id of indirect object being referenced (version independent)

flags.name: --elements
flags.description: type of elements to select (cxtsi)

flags.name: --raw
flags.description: raw output for data and filters

flags.name: --stats
flags.description: display stats for pdf document

flags.name: --type
flags.description: type of indirect object to select

flags.name: --objstm
flags.description: parse stream of /ObjStm objects

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: display malformed PDF elements

flags.name: --extract
flags.description: filename to extract malformed content to

flags.name: --hash
flags.description: display hash of objects

flags.name: --nocanonicalizedoutput
flags.description: do not canonicalize the output

flags.name: --dump
flags.description: filename to dump stream content to

flags.name: --debug
flags.description: display debug info

flags.name: --content
flags.description: display the content for objects without streams or with streams without filters

flags.name: --searchstream
flags.description: string to search in streams

flags.name: --unfiltered
flags.description: search in unfiltered streams

flags.name: --casesensitive
flags.description: case sensitive search in streams

flags.name: --regex
flags.description: use regex to search in streams

flags.name: --overridingfilters
flags.description: override filters with given filters (use raw for the raw stream content)

flags.name: --generate
flags.description: generate a Python program that creates the parsed PDF file

flags.name: --generateembedded
flags.description: generate a Python program that embeds the selected indirect object as a file

flags.name: --yara
flags.description: YARA rule (or directory or @file) to check streams (can be used with option --unfiltered)

flags.name: --yarastrings
flags.description: Print YARA strings

flags.name: --decoders
flags.description: decoders to load (separate decoders with a comma , ; @file supported)

flags.name: --decoderoptions
flags.description: options for the decoder

flags.name: --key
flags.description: key to search in dictionaries

flags.name: --jsonoutput
flags.description: produce json output
